budget_items.what_was_said: Facilities director got a quote to replace the chain-hung sign, which had broken repeatedly, with a new pole-mounted sign. Cost quoted with installation, to be paid from the parks revolving account.

budget_items.topic: Genevieve Nass Memorial Beach House sign
budget_items.what_was_said: A quote was obtained to design, remove the old sign, and install a new beach house sign. A donor was said to be willing to cover most of the cost.

budget_items.topic: Town beach revenue vs. salary costs
budget_items.what_was_said: The facilities director said town beach pass and lesson revenue covers around half of the town beach's salary expenses, with the town covering the rest.
The chair listed the current resident family, individual, senior, and daily pass rates, last raised in 2024.
The chair proposed roughly doubling all beach pass and swim lesson rates to move toward a self-sustaining program, citing the family pass as an example.
The chair cited Holden's pool family and individual pass prices as a comparison point for the proposed increase.
A member cited a local country club's non-resident and resident family and individual pool membership prices as further comparison.

budget_items.topic: Non-resident youth club field use fee
budget_items.what_was_said: The chair described the current per-child non-resident youth organization field fee as possibly too low for an outside club-level team using fields extensively, compared to what Lunenburg's own program pays for a season.
The chair described DCR's hourly and seasonal block rental rates for fields as a possible alternative pricing model to consider.

budget_items.topic: Existing one-time non-resident grass field rate
budget_items.what_was_said: The chair noted the current one-time non-resident grass field hourly rate while questioning whether the commission has too many overlapping fee tiers.

decisions.decision: Commission will approve the Fitzgerald Field sign tonight but plans a formal revote next meeting so the agenda item correctly names Fitzgerald rather than McNeil field.
No vote taken on beach fee increases tonight; chair will bring it back as an agenda item with more numbers and an opportunity for public feedback.
Commission received abutter notice of zoning board of appeals and planning board meetings on a proposed Dunkin Donuts at 947 Massachusetts Avenue; no action taken unless a member has concerns.
Field use policy and signage policy are not being approved tonight; members will redline and provide feedback before the next meeting.
Non-resident/private club field use fee structure will be reviewed and redlined by members before the next meeting rather than changed tonight.
Next regular meeting set for February 25.
A special meeting was set for February 3, via Zoom, open to the public.

what_happened.line: The Parks Commission opened discussion on roughly doubling town beach pass and lesson fees to make the beach self-sustaining, but took no vote.
The commission approved funding a replacement sign for Fitzgerald Field, to be paid from the parks revolving account.
The commission approved a private-donation project letting Lunenburg Youth Baseball demolish and rebuild two dugouts at Powell Field.
Draft field-use, signage, and non-resident field-fee policies were held for member redlines rather than adopted, to return next meeting.
The chair said town beach pass and lesson revenue covers about half of the beach's salary costs, with the town covering the rest.

why_it_matters: A resident beach-pass household could see rates move toward roughly double what they pay now, once a formal proposal comes back with numbers and public comment.
The push ties to town budget pressure: the commission is weighing whether beach and field fees should cover more of their own costs rather than draw on the town.
Non-resident and private-club field fees are also under review, which could change what outside youth sports organizations pay to use Lunenburg's fields.
